criteria: RCTs, 2020+, cognitive outcomes in MCI patients

source_review.title: Effect of Multicomponent Exercise on Cognition, Physical Function and Activities of Daily Life in Older Adults With Dementia or Mild Cognitive Impairment: A Systematic Review and Meta-analysis
source_review.journal: Archives of Physical Medicine and Rehabilitation

conclusion_summary: Regular exercise, particularly aerobic and resistance training, shows moderate benefit for cognitive function in MCI patients.
limitations: High heterogeneity in exercise prescriptions across studies
Difficulty blinding participants in exercise trials
